About Me

I'm a passionate AI/ML engineer and computer science student deeply interested in building intelligent systems. With a strong foundation in deep learning, NLP, and computer vision, I'm driven to solve real-world problems using cutting-edge AI technologies.

Whether it's fine-tuning large language models, building RAG pipelines, or optimizing neural networks, I love the challenge of pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI. I'm currently seeking internship opportunities to apply and expand my skills.

Outside of coding, you'll find me exploring new ML research papers, contributing to open-source projects, or working on side projects that combine my interests in AI and software engineering.
